item.title: Official entry info for Chad was updated (Nov 4, 2026). Travel advice: Level 4 🔴 Do not travel
item.dc:creator: 🇹🇩 Chad
item.description: UK government note: "This travel advice has been reviewed for accuracy with changes made throughout, including updated information about applying for a visa, terrorism in Chad, terrorist kidnapping, political situation, robbery, protecting yourself and your belongings, Ramadan, driving standards and security, travelling outside N'Djamena, regional risks, health risks you may face in Chad, including Dengue and emergency numbers if your require police, ambulance or fire services ('Entry requirements', 'Safety and security', 'Regional risks', 'Health' and 'Getting help' pages)." Updates like this can affect other passports too, so check the official entry rules for your passport before you book or travel. From The Escape Plan travel data. General information, not legal advice. Always check the official source before you travel.
